## **1. Load Required Libraries**

```{r setup-libraries, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(PLS205)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(lme4)

```


## **2. Load and Format Data**

```{r read-datam message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Read in the data
data <- read.csv("Species Count.csv")


# Convert to factors
data$sample = as.factor(data$sample)
data$burn = as.factor(data$burn)
data$rack = as.factor(data$rack)
data$drought = as.factor(data$drought)


# Reformat burn column
data <- data %>%
mutate(
burn = factor(burn,
levels = c("h", "ln", "lo", "n"),
labels = c("High", "Low (Initial)", "Low (Advanced)", "Suppressed"))
)
```



```{r define-colors}

# Colorblind-friendly palette
burn_colors_cb <- c(
"High" = hcl(h = 15, c = 75, l = 55),
"Low (Initial)" = hcl(h = 260, c = 60, l = 65),
"Low (Advanced)" = hcl(h = 75, c = 65, l = 75),
"Suppressed" = hcl(h = 330, c = 50, l = 70)
)
```


# **2. Linear Model and Analysis**

```{r}

# MODEL COMPARISON: ALL-TAXA SPECIES RICHNESS

# Full model
species_model_full <- lm(
  number_of_species ~ burn * drought,
  data = data
)

# Additive model
species_model_additive <- lm(
  number_of_species ~ burn + drought,
  data = data
)

# Burn-only model
species_model_burn <- lm(
  number_of_species ~ burn,
  data = data
)

# Nested model comparison
anova(
  species_model_burn,
  species_model_additive,
  species_model_full
)

# Compare AIC
AIC(
  species_model_burn,
  species_model_additive,
  species_model_full
)
```

```{r}

# MODEL COMPARISON: EMF SPECIES RICHNESS

# Full model
emf_model_full <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn * drought,
  data = data
)

# Additive model
emf_model_additive <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn + drought,
  data = data
)

# Burn-only model
emf_model_burn <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn,
  data = data
)

# Nested model comparison
anova(
  emf_model_burn,
  emf_model_additive,
  emf_model_full
)

# Compare AIC
AIC(
  emf_model_burn,
  emf_model_additive,
  emf_model_full
)
```

```{r}

# TEST RACK RANDOM EFFECT: ALL-TAXA RICHNESS


species_model_rack <- lmer(
  number_of_species ~ burn + (1 | rack),
  data = data,
  REML = FALSE
)

species_model_fixed <- lm(
  number_of_species ~ burn,
  data = data
)

VarCorr(species_model_rack)
isSingular(species_model_rack)

AIC(
  species_model_fixed,
  species_model_rack
)



# TEST RACK RANDOM EFFECT: EcM RICHNESS


emf_model_rack <- lmer(
  emf_species ~ burn + (1 | rack),
  data = data,
  REML = FALSE
)

emf_model_fixed <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn,
  data = data
)

VarCorr(emf_model_rack)
isSingular(emf_model_rack)

AIC(
  emf_model_fixed,
  emf_model_rack
)
```


```{r}
# Fit model
species_model <- lm(number_of_species ~ burn, data = data)

anova(species_model)

```

```{r}

# Diagnostics
pls205_diagnostics(species_model)

# No Scale-Location... try base R
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(species_model)

```


```{r normality, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, include=FALSE}
# Double-check Q-Q plot
qqnorm(resid(species_model), 
       main = "Normal Q-Q Plot for species_model",
       pch = 19, col = "black")
qqline(resid(species_model), col = "blue", lwd = 2)
```


```{r lm-anova-species}

# Estimated marginal means
species_means <- emmeans(species_model, ~ burn)
species_means

# Pairwise comparisons with Tukey adjustment
pairs(species_means, adjust = "tukey")

# CLD table
species_cld <- cld(
  species_means,
  Letters = letters,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

species_cld
```



```{r lm-anova-emf}

# Final model for EcM species richness
emf_model <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn,
  data = data
)

# ANOVA
anova(emf_model)

# Estimated marginal means
emf_means <- emmeans(emf_model, ~ burn)
emf_means

# Pairwise comparisons with Tukey adjustment
pairs(emf_means, adjust = "tukey")

# CLD table
species_emf_cld <- cld(
  emf_means,
  Letters = letters,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

species_emf_cld
```

# **3. Create Plots and Combine**


```{r plot-all-tax}

# Prepare CLD labels directly from emmeans output
cld_all <- as.data.frame(species_cld) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    burn = factor(
      burn,
      levels = c(
        "High",
        "Low (Initial)",
        "Low (Advanced)",
        "Suppressed"
      )
    ),
    label = trimws(.group),
    y = 6.5
  )

# Plot
all_species_plot <- ggplot(
  data,
  aes(
    x = burn,
    y = number_of_species,
    fill = burn
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.2,
      height = 0.2
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cld_all,
    aes(
      x = burn,
      y = y,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fire History",
    y = "Species Count",
    title = "All Taxa"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = burn_colors_cb
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 7)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

all_species_plot




```

```{r final-combined-species-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}

library(patchwork)

# Remove individual x-axis titles and add spacing below tick labels
all_species_plot <- all_species_plot +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 5, b = 8)
    )
  )

emf_species_plot <- emf_species_plot +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 5, b = 8)
    )
  )

# Combine main panels
species_panels <- 
  (all_species_plot | plot_spacer() | emf_species_plot) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.02, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
    )
  )

# Shared x-axis title
shared_x_title <- ggplot() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(x = "Fire History") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14,
      margin = margin(t = 3)
    )
  )

# Final Figure 4
combined_species_plot <- species_panels / shared_x_title +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.045))

combined_species_plot

```

```{r}
# Save Figure 4: Species Richness
ggsave(
  "Figure_4_Species_Richness_Revised.png",
  plot = combined_species_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "Figure_4_Species_Richness_Revised.pdf",
  plot = combined_species_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
```



```{r}

library(car)
# -----------------------------
# ALL-TAXA SPECIES RICHNESS
# Exploratory full-factorial check
# -----------------------------

species_model_fulltest <- lm(
  number_of_species ~ burn * drought,
  data = data
)

car::Anova(species_model_fulltest, type = 3)

species_burn_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  species_model_fulltest,
  ~ burn
)

species_drought_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  species_model_fulltest,
  ~ drought
)

species_interaction_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  species_model_fulltest,
  ~ burn * drought
)

pairs(
  species_burn_emm_fulltest,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

pairs(
  emmeans(species_model_fulltest, ~ burn | drought),
  adjust = "tukey"
)

pairs(
  emmeans(species_model_fulltest, ~ drought | burn),
  adjust = "tukey"
)


# -----------------------------
# EMF SPECIES RICHNESS
# Exploratory full-factorial check
# -----------------------------

emf_model_fulltest <- lm(
  emf_species ~ burn * drought,
  data = data
)

car::Anova(emf_model_fulltest, type = 3)

emf_burn_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  emf_model_fulltest,
  ~ burn
)

emf_drought_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  emf_model_fulltest,
  ~ drought
)

emf_interaction_emm_fulltest <- emmeans(
  emf_model_fulltest,
  ~ burn * drought
)

pairs(
  emf_burn_emm_fulltest,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

pairs(
  emmeans(emf_model_fulltest, ~ burn | drought),
  adjust = "tukey"
)

pairs(
  emmeans(emf_model_fulltest, ~ drought | burn),
  adjust = "tukey"
)
```

##**Coefficient Tables for Supplemental**
```{r}
library(broom)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)

# All-taxa richness coefficients
species_coef <- broom::tidy(species_model) %>%
  mutate(
    Term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
      "burnLow (Initial)" = "Low (Initial)",
      "burnLow (Advanced)" = "Low (Advanced)",
      "burnSuppressed" = "Suppressed"
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Term,
    Estimate = estimate,
    `Std. Error` = std.error,
    `t value` = statistic,
    `p value` = p.value,
    Significance
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = round(Estimate, 4),
    `Std. Error` = round(`Std. Error`, 4),
    `t value` = round(`t value`, 4),
    `p value` = ifelse(
      `p value` < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", `p value`)
    )
  )


# EMF richness coefficients
emf_coef <- broom::tidy(emf_model) %>%
  mutate(
    Term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
      "burnLow (Initial)" = "Low (Initial)",
      "burnLow (Advanced)" = "Low (Advanced)",
      "burnSuppressed" = "Suppressed"
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Term,
    Estimate = estimate,
    `Std. Error` = std.error,
    `t value` = statistic,
    `p value` = p.value,
    Significance
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = round(Estimate, 4),
    `Std. Error` = round(`Std. Error`, 4),
    `t value` = round(`t value`, 4),
    `p value` = ifelse(
      `p value` < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", `p value`)
    )
  )


species_ft <- flextable(species_coef) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

emf_ft <- flextable(emf_coef) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()
```
